title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
summary: Google’s version, TorchTPU, lets AI apps run on Google’s AI chips, called Tensor Processing Units (TPUs). It also makes it easy to move existing PyTorch apps to TPUs and, therefore, to Google Cloud.
